sample_table.help_text: `path` points to a CellRanger/STARsolo output directory (any CellRanger flavour), a `.h5` file or a `.mtx` directory. With `--on_irods` it is an iRODS collection instead. See `examples/sample_table.csv`.

on_irods.description: Paths in `--sample_table` are iRODS collections; download them first.

ignore_extensions.description: Comma-separated file extensions to skip when downloading from iRODS.

publish_mode.description: How published files are written into `--output_dir`.

version.help_text: Passing `--version 0.2` on the command line gives a number, so both `0.2` and `"0.2"` are accepted.

cells.help_text: Required together with `--droplets` for version 0.2 when the sample table points to `.h5` files or `.mtx` directories. Otherwise version 0.2 estimates it with the mapper preset and version 0.3 with CellBender's own estimation.

droplets.description: Total number of droplets to include (`--total-droplets-included`).
droplets.help_text: Required together with `--cells` for version 0.2 when the sample table points to `.h5` files or `.mtx` directories.

mapper_preset.description: Estimate `--cells`, `--droplets` and `--min_umi` from the CellRanger/STARsolo output.
mapper_preset.help_text: Needs the whole mapper output directory as `path`. Always on for version 0.2 unless both `--cells` and `--droplets` are given.

starsolo_mapper.description: STARsolo output type to use as CellBender input (e.g. `Gene`, `GeneFull`, `GeneFull_Ex50pAS`).

exclude_features.description: Feature types to exclude from the analysis.
exclude_features.help_text: Version 0.3: comma-separated list of `Antibody Capture`, `CRISPR Guide Capture`, `Custom`, `Peaks`, `Multiplexing Capture`, `VDJ`, `VDJ-T`, `VDJ-T-GD`, `VDJ-B`, `Antigen Capture`. Version 0.2: only `All` (excludes antibody capture).

min_umi.description: Lower bound for empty-droplet UMI count (`--low-count-threshold`).

force_empty_umi_prior.description: Force the empty-droplet UMI count prior (version 0.3 only).

qc_mode.help_text: 1: log-based summary and training curves only; 2: also cell probabilities from the output `.h5`; 3: also soup fraction.

gpuqueue.description: LSF GPU queue for CellBender jobs. `cub` and `tiger` queues require `--costcode`.

costcode.description: Costcode to bill GPU jobs to (lowercased). Required for `cub` and `tiger` queues.

ignore_failed.description: Ignore CellBender jobs that still fail on the final retry instead of stopping the pipeline.

help.description: Show the help message; pass a parameter name for its detailed help.

helpFull.description: Show the help message for all parameters.

showHidden.description: Show hidden parameters in the help message.

then.errorMessage: CellBender 0.2 needs `--cells` and `--droplets` together, or neither to use the mapper preset

exclude_features.pattern: ^\s*(Antibody Capture|CRISPR Guide Capture|Custom|Peaks|Multiplexing Capture|VDJ|VDJ\-T|VDJ\-T\-GD|VDJ\-B|Antigen Capture)\s*(,\s*(Antibody Capture|CRISPR Guide Capture|Custom|Peaks|Multiplexing Capture|VDJ|VDJ\-T|VDJ\-T\-GD|VDJ\-B|Antigen Capture)\s*)*$
exclude_features.errorMessage: CellBender 0.3 takes a comma-separated list of: Antibody Capture, CRISPR Guide Capture, Custom, Peaks, Multiplexing Capture, VDJ, VDJ-T, VDJ-T-GD, VDJ-B, Antigen Capture
